about_the_game:
Step into a fresh new corner of Spirit City's room with the Cozy Kitchen DLC! This feast of a DLC expands your Spirit City experience with a brand-new kitchen area.

We've whipped up a tasty menu of new activities for your avatar - from cooking comforting meals, to cleaning the dishes, to unwinding in the kitchen's cozy breakfast nook.

But that's not all—this DLC serves up a new batch of Spirits who each bring their own unique flavor to the kitchen. With a pantry stocked with food-themed customization options, you'll have every ingredient you'll need for a great, relaxing time!

What’s Cooking in the Cozy Kitchen Expansion?

  • Three New Spirits to Befriend – New adorable Spirits to keep you company in the Kitchen - Including Capybun, a loaf-life capybara and Squire Sprout, a vegetable knight-in-training

  • Nine Discoverable Spirit Variants – Expand your Spiritdex with unique and rare versions of your favorite spirits - Including Bentobunny, a variant of Dustbunny who loves sleeping in packed lunches and Toast-mate, a retro toaster variant of APE-bit.

  • A Fully Customizable Kitchen – Personalize your dream kitchen with new decor options, including countertops, backsplashes, cabinets, and a cozy breakfast nook.

  • Expanded Spiritdex – A dedicated new Spiritdex page for your culinary-themed spirit friends.

  • New Avatar Items – Look the part as you don new aprons and chefs hats for your avatar.

  • New Kitchen Activities – Enjoy cozy kitchen tasks like chopping veggies, cooking and washing dishes to enhance your daily productivity and relaxation.
